ways.note: Dozens of flights a day; the airport is ten minutes from the centre.

sources.title: Ho Chi Minh City to Da Nang: every way to go
sources.quote: The flight from Ho Chi Minh City to Da Nang takes about 1 hour 25 minutes.

sources.title: Ho Chi Minh City to Da Nang: every way to go
sources.quote: The Reunification Express reaches Da Nang in around 17 hours.
Saigon to Da Nang by sleeper train: 17 hours.

ways.note: Sleeper buses leave in the evening.
